deduction_items.source_location: instruction.md, materials, and frozen Golden shape
deduction_items.normalization: parse JSON values without string coercion and compare finite numeric values at full precision
deduction_items.trigger_predicate: a reward target is outside zero to one
deduction_items.occurrence: one independently bound object or sequence root cause
deduction_items.root_cause_deduplication: deduplicate by defect family and bound record identity
deduction_items.evidence_span: one record or one coherent record sequence
deduction_items.parse_failure_boundary: parsing uncertainty remains local and does not imply unrelated semantic defects
deduction_items.exclusions: exclude ordinary omission, legal equivalents, quoted candidates, and rejected claims unless a separate contradiction is adopted
